name: Port Razer
oracle_text:
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, untap each creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
This creature can't attack a player it has already attacked this turn.
blocked_sentences: This creature can't attack a player it has already attacked this turn.

needs.what: a static attack restriction on the source creature that forbids declaring it as an attacker against any player (or that player's planeswalkers are still allowed) whom this same creature has already attacked earlier this turn, read from a per-creature, per-turn record of the players it attacked
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `cant_attack` and `cant_attack_you` statics are filters on the attacking creature or scoped to the static's controller's seat and never consult which defenders a creature attacked this turn; the static filter keys have no `attacked_this_turn`-by-defender reading. The `cant_attack_player` op names a defending player but is a one-shot effect; driving it from an `attacks` trigger would be a triggered emulation of a static (it can be countered or Stifled, and misses attacks while the trigger is pending), so it is not exact.
